decisions.title: UQ-P10-01 — Pure in-process execution for the initial slice
decisions.decision: The initial P10 slice executes purely in-process: no HTTP socket, no loopback bind, and no network-exposed backend surface. backend.exposure_class is LOCAL_NON_NETWORK_EXPOSED. No authentication, CSRF, or rate-limiting control implementation is triggered by this choice.
decisions.reason: Static in-process output satisfies the P9 audit contract without any socket, giving the narrowest blast radius for the first slice. Matches the UQ-P10-01 recommended option and preserves the D-P10-1 boundary.

alternatives.option: Loopback HTTP bind for local preview, still LOCAL_NON_NETWORK_EXPOSED
alternatives.why_not_chosen: Wider local blast radius than a static slice requires; unnecessary for the P9 audit contract.

alternatives.option: Defer the backend-surface decision until the first section's needs are known
alternatives.why_not_chosen: Unnecessary delay; static in-process output already satisfies the first slice.

approval.basis: Explicit human User authorization, 2026-10-16, in the Round 12 decision message: 'DEC-7101: OPTION A'. Ratifies this delegated technical direction (pure in-process execution; no HTTP socket, no loopback bind, no network-exposed backend surface; backend.exposure_class is LOCAL_NON_NETWORK_EXPOSED). The verbatim Round 12 decision message is transcribed in sps2/decisions/P10-ROUND12-USER-DECISIONS.json. The ratification applies only to this decision; it does not authorize implementation, publication, or any git stage/commit/push.

decisions.title: UQ-P10-02 — No fixed viewport width range adopted
decisions.decision: No fixed viewport width range is imposed as a P10 requirement at this stage. Responsive behaviour is expressed through objective, machine-checkable structural assertions (a viewport meta tag is present; no document relies on a single fixed pixel width) rather than an inherited numeric range.
decisions.reason: Any numeric range adopted now would be inherited from the legacy 320-1440px range without repository evidence, which D-P10-4 forbids. Matches the UQ-P10-02 recommended option.

alternatives.option: Adopt the legacy 320-1440px range with per-bound assertions
alternatives.why_not_chosen: Imports an unevidenced legacy range; forbidden by D-P10-4.

alternatives.option: Adopt a set of named design breakpoints
alternatives.why_not_chosen: No design contract exists yet to justify them.

approval.basis: Explicit human User authorization, 2026-10-16, in the Round 12 decision message: 'DEC-7102: OPTION A'. decisions.title: UQ-P10-03 — Evidence-based accessibility checks; no blanket WCAG AA
decisions.decision: Accessibility is evaluated through objective, evidence-backed, machine-checkable checks retained under P10 (documents declare their language; a viewport meta tag is present; exactly one h1 with no heading-level jumps; images carry CMS-authored alt text or are explicitly marked decorative). No blanket WCAG AA conformance level is asserted at this stage.
decisions.reason: A blanket AA claim is not verifiable from repository evidence here and was recorded in the baseline audit as asserted without citation; D-P10-4 forbids importing the legacy AA level. Matches the UQ-P10-03 recommended option.

decisions.title: UQ-P10-04 — Design-system implementation is not a prerequisite for the first slice
decisions.decision: A separate design-system implementation is not a prerequisite for producing the first P10 slice. Structural, content-safety, output-safety and security criteria are sufficient to judge the first slice; any design-system criteria apply forward and are not retroactively imposed on it.
decisions.reason: Keeps the first slice unblocked while no design contract exists, without lowering the machine-checkable bar. Matches the UQ-P10-04 recommended option.
